draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.35, the 32nd-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 1st of 21 at S. He went 43rd overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Jessie Bates. Testing concerns: vertical jump (16th percentile). College production: 47 tackles in 2020, 9th of 21 Ss in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 6 pro, currently with the Carolina Panthers. 82 career games and 80 starts over 5 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. Trending down from his peak: 5 AV in 2025 against a career-best 7 in 2024. Strengths in 2025: combined tackles 103 (88th percentile), season snap share 93.7% (85th percentile), missed tackle rate 5.5% (81st percentile). Versus the typical Year-5 safety who played: 93.7% season snap share against a median of 59.9%, above the norm.
